project.name: Warbuilder
project.concept: A warzone deckbuilder: start with a 10-card deck, loot guns and tactical cards across 7 locations while the gas closes in; playable in the browser and as print-and-play.
project.unique_selling_point: Imported HTML5 game from DeVoTeD-Qc/wardeckbuilder, to be improved by the studio.
project.engine_override_reason: Imported from DeVoTeD-Qc/wardeckbuilder; the studio head chose to keep HTML5/JS (2026-11-04).

development_rules: Engine exception: HTML5/JavaScript (imported project), not Godot

risks.mitigation: Strict feature freeze after design phase
